_note: A development whose marketing name is not the name OneMap holds for its building, linked BY HAND from a published source (the developer's release or the project's own address). fetch-onemap-names.js reads this file: it asks OneMap for `building` and keeps only the records at the listed postal codes. Add an entry only when a source states the link; never on a similar-looking name.
